topic: Unit 9: Chemical Equilibrium (Reversible Reactions, Dynamic Equilibrium, Law of Mass Action, Equilibrium Constant Kc & Le Chatelier's Principle)
activities: Investigate factors affecting equilibrium using Le Chatelier's principle; exothermic and endothermic reaction word banks; Chem 10 equilibrium wet lab simulation; Kc expression derivations.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 9), Caravan Book House Unit 9, Complete Chemistry OUP Unit 10, Chemguide chemical equilibria.

topic: Unit 10: Acids, Bases and Salts (Arrhenius, Brønsted-Lowry & Lewis Concepts, pH & pOH Scale, Acid-Base Titration, Preparation & Types of Salts)
activities: Test chemical properties of household acids and bases (vinegar, juices, cleaners); PhET pH Scale and Neutralisation simulations; volumetric acid-base titration calculations; precipitation of insoluble salts.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 10), STBB Chemistry Class X Chapter 2, Caravan Book House Unit 10, PhET Acid-Base Solutions.

topic: Unit 11: Organic Chemistry (Characteristics of Organic Compounds, Classification, Homologous Series, Functional Groups, Isomerism & IUPAC Nomenclature)
activities: Molecular kit building of alkanes, alkenes, alkynes; functional group flashcard sorting; structural isomerism modeling; Chemguide IUPAC nomenclature worksheets.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 11), Caravan Book House Unit 11, STBB Chemistry Class XII Chapter 3, Teachoo isomerism tutorials.

topic: Unit 12: Hydrocarbons (Alkanes, Alkenes & Alkynes: Preparation, Combustion, Halogenation, Baeyer's Test & Acidity of Terminal Alkynes)
activities: Systematic IUPAC nomenclature practice; reaction flowcharts for addition and substitution reactions; Baeyer's KMnO4 unsaturation test; combustion stoichiometric calculations.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 12), PTBB Chemistry Class 10 Chapter 17, All About Chemistry O Level (Hodder), University of Calgary organic nomenclature.

topic: Unit 13: Natural and Synthetic Polymers (Addition & Condensation Polymerisation, Carbohydrates, Proteins & Enzymes, Lipids, Nucleic Acids & Vitamins)
activities: Classify dietary macromolecules; test solubility of monosaccharides and disaccharides in hot and cold water; illustrate peptide linkage formation; protein denaturation video analysis.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 13), Caravan Book House Unit 13, Complete Chemistry OUP Unit 17, Glencoe Protein Denaturation modules.

topic: Unit 14: Environmental Chemistry I: Atmosphere (Layers of Atmosphere, Air Pollutants: CO, SO2, NOx, Acid Rain, Ozone Depletion & Global Warming)
activities: Atmospheric layers worksheets; air quality monitoring (PM2.5, CO2, ozone); simulated acid rain model with dilute acid on plants; greenhouse effect container demonstration.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 14), Caravan Book House Unit 14, NOAA Earth Spheres resources, eLearn air pollution activities.

topic: Unit 15: Environmental Chemistry II: Water (Properties of Water, Hardness: Temporary & Permanent, Removal Methods: Clark's & Zeolite, Water Pollution & Waterborne Diseases)
activities: Water testing for soft and hard water with soap solution and test strips; case studies on waterborne pathogens (Naegleria, typhoid, cholera); wastewater treatment flow diagrams.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 15), PTBB Class 10 Chapter 11, STBB Class X Chapter 6, LibreTexts Water Properties.

topic: Unit 16: Chemical Industries (Metallurgy of Copper & Iron, Solvay Process for Na2CO3, Haber Process for NH3, Contact Process for H2SO4 & Petroleum Refining)
activities: Flowcharts for blast furnace iron extraction and copper roasting/smelting; matching chemical processes with catalysts and conditions; fractional distillation column diagrams.
resources: Chemistry for Grade 10 NBF (Unit 16), Caravan Book House Unit 16, Prescott O Level Chemistry, Chemguide extraction of metals.
